sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Concerto for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 4. If Concerto is applied to allies as well, status ailments, debuffs, Cost reduction, and Unison gauge reduction will also be nullified based on the number of members (excluding self) in Concerto state).
[Unison Effect Boost] Changes the effect value of "Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 50 for 120 seconds" to 100.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000
Only [Glitzy Splash] Sandy Shore You can be used as Unlocking Potential material
